name: jag-insight
description: AI quota and usage monitor for Antigravity IDE and Visual Studio Code

commands.title: JAG Insights: Install Claude Code Usage Capture

jagInsights.enabled.description: Enable or disable JAG Insights status bar item.

jagInsights.pollIntervalMs.description: Polling interval in milliseconds to check local quota.

jagInsights.freshnessThresholdMs.description: Age in milliseconds after which provider data is marked stale. Effective threshold is never shorter than three polling intervals.

jagInsights.showUserEmail.description: Display user email in the status bar tooltip and details panel.

jagInsights.showPromptCredits.description: Display total prompt credits in status bar tooltip and details panel.

jagInsights.showQuotaOnStatusBar.description: Show integrated quota percentages (AG, CX, CL) directly on the status bar text.

jagInsights.statusBarFormat.default: $(hubot) AG(Gemini {ag}, Codex {agcx}, Claude {agcc}) | Codex:{cx} | Claude Code:{cc}
jagInsights.statusBarFormat.description: Format template. Placeholders: {ag} (Antigravity Gemini), {agcx} (Antigravity Codex), {agcc}/{agcl}/{cl} (Antigravity Claude), {cx} (Codex CLI), {cc} (Claude Code CLI). AG shows remaining quota. Codex and Claude Code show usage; {cc} lists available 5-hour, weekly, and model-specific weekly limits.

jagInsights.claudeCodeUsagePath.description: Path to the Claude Code rate-limit cache written by the JAG Insights statusLine capture.

jagInsights.claudeCodeStatePath.description: Optional legacy Claude Code monitor state file.

jagInsights.codexSessionPath.description: Optional Codex sessions directory. Empty automatically uses $CODEX_HOME/sessions or ~/.codex/sessions.

jagInsights.codexStatePath.description: Deprecated legacy setting. JAG Insights now uses Codex sessions or the optional app-server integration.
jagInsights.codexStatePath.deprecationMessage: This setting is no longer used. Configure jagInsights.codexSessionPath or jagInsights.codexUseAppServer instead.

jagInsights.codexUseAppServer.description: Optionally use the documented Codex app-server account/rateLimits/read method, with local session files as fallback. This can make a network request through Codex.

jagInsights.codexAppServerCommand.description: Codex executable used for the optional app-server integration.

jagInsights.geminiSessionPath.description: Optional Gemini CLI session root. Empty detects current ~/.gemini/tmp/<project>/chats JSON/JSONL and legacy ~/.gemini/sessions data.

jagInsights.geminiTelemetryPath.description: Optional local Gemini CLI OpenTelemetry log. Configure Gemini telemetry with target=local and logPrompts=false.
